d: UBS is reportedly considering shifting hundreds of jobs from Europe to India over the next two years as the Swiss banking giant looks to reduce costs and streamline its global operations. The proposed relocation could affect roles in finance, compliance, risk management, legal services, human resources and operations, with several positions currently based in Poland. The move comes as UBS expands its India operations, including plans to strengthen its technology and AI capabilities. Is India emerging as the next major global banking hub?
